notes.title: "Outlying Islands" Now Available!
notes.notes:
[p]Our game "Outlying Islands" officially launches on Steam today. 

"Outlying Islands" is a horror adventure puzzle game. Step onto this mysterious island sealed by authorities - a layered dimension forged by aberrant energies. The island teems with indescribable eldritch creatures, where spatial rifts interweave and reality collides with nightmarish visions. Only through deep exploration can you gradually unravel the mysteries behind this land and confront the primordial truth shrouded in mist. 
※Game currently supports Chinese only

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2966510/_/"][/dynamiclink]

If you encounter any issues while playing, please join our [url="https://2pgames.net/discord"]2pgames.net/discord[/url] channels to share your gameplay experience and suggestions. Thank you all for your continued support![/p]

notes.title: 《离岛》试玩DEMO现已公开
notes.notes:
亲爱的玩家，你们好。

感谢各位长期的关注与支持。今天我们怀着难以名状的战栗与期待，向各位开放《离岛》的试玩DEMO。这不仅仅是一次试玩——而是一次共谋。

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2966510/_/
在本次试玩中，您将踏入《离岛》这个充满不可名状恐怖的世界。这里游荡着难以描述的畸形生物，您将揭开尘封的旧日悲剧，破译那些似乎具有自我意识的诡异机关。我们希望能够通过本次试玩，获得来自各位的反馈及建议，你们的每一条建议对于我们来说都无比珍贵，在后续的开发过程中，我们也会根据这些反馈建议，有针对性地调整优化游戏体验。

本次试玩DEMO不代表游戏最终品质，在DEMO试玩过程中有任何的问题及BUG反馈都可以向我们提出。在此再次感谢各位对《离岛》的关注及支持，在接下来的日子里，我们将与你们一同凝视深渊...
